when.quote: Ask for the replacement reason and record exactly one of: fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or other.

starts.note: customer: only when the customer asks to cancel, replace or reissue a credit card, or agrees to the replacement offered after they reported unauthorized charges. For fraud_suspected or stolen, the agent strongly recommends expedited shipping. If the customer also asked for a credit limit increase on the same card and it has not been decided, a pending replacement would block it. Tell them before ordering and offer to do the increase first (cli_conflict_notice).
starts.quote: 'cancel_and_reissue': The card is being cancelled and a replacement issued (use when user wants card replaced

tools.not_used: Not used in this job. A dispute is a separate job, done only if the customer asks for one. If it is filed after this replacement, its card_action is cancel_and_reissue.
Not used in this job. A credit limit increase is processed only in processing_cli_approvals_and_denials. cli_conflict_notice only offers to do it first.

info.about: Which credit card account to replace, when the customer has more than one
info.ask: Which credit card would you like to replace?

info.about: Exactly one of fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, other. Unrecognized charges with the card still in hand mean fraud_suspected.
info.ask: What is the reason for the replacement: suspected fraud, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or something else?

info.about: Where to ship the new card: the primary address on file, or an alternate address the customer gives (such as work), including any unit or suite. The customer may say they want a different address only when asked.
info.ask: Where should we ship the replacement card: your address on file, or a different address? Please include any unit or suite number.

info.about: standard (7–10 business days, free) or expedited (2–3 business days, fee by card tier)
info.ask: Would you like standard shipping (7–10 business days, free) or expedited shipping (2–3 business days, with a fee that depends on your card tier)?

info.about: The customer's agreement to the expedited fee for their tier, needed only when a fee applies
info.ask: Expedited shipping for your card carries a fee of [tier fee]. Do you agree to this fee?

info.about: Tier of the card being replaced, read from the card type on the account record
When the customer also wants a credit limit increase on the same card, not yet decided: whether they want it handled before the replacement is ordered
info.ask: A pending replacement card would hold up the credit limit increase until it is delivered. Would you like me to handle the credit limit increase first?

steps.do: Make sure the customer was verified and logged earlier in this conversation. If not, do the verification steps of review_recent_credit_card_transactions (or filing_a_credit_card_transaction_dispute) first: lookup, 2 matching values, get_current_time, log_verification.
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: If a replacement for this card was already ordered earlier in this conversation (for example in the dispute job's replacement_branch), do not order again. Confirm the existing order's address, speed and delivery window to the customer, and skip the remaining ordering steps.
steps.if: order_replacement_credit_card_7291 already succeeded for this card in this conversation
steps.quote: You cannot submit another replacement while an existing request is still being processed.

steps.do: Get the verified user's credit card accounts and pick the account of the card to replace. Note its account id and card type (tier). If the customer has more than one card, ask which one.
steps.quote: Look up the customer's credit card account.

steps.do: Before ordering, tell the customer that a pending replacement card would block the credit limit increase until it is delivered or cancelled. Offer to handle the increase first. If they agree, run processing_cli_approvals_and_denials now (no new verification), then come back here. If they want the replacement first, continue here. Order nothing in this step.
steps.if: the customer also asked in this conversation for a credit limit increase on the same card, and it has not yet been decided
steps.quote: If a replacement is pending, the CLI cannot be processed until the replacement is delivered or cancelled.

steps.do: Confirm the replacement reason and record exactly one value. Use fraud_suspected when the customer reports unrecognized charges (stolen or lost if they say the card itself is gone).
steps.quote: Ask for the replacement reason and record exactly one of: fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or other.

steps.do: Unlock the tool that checks for pending replacement orders
steps.quote: To check if a credit card account has any pending replacement card orders, use the get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 tool.

steps.do: Check the account for an existing replacement order that is still pending

arguments.credit_card_account_id: the account id of the card being replaced, from get_cc_account

steps.quote: You cannot submit another replacement while an existing request is still being processed.

steps.do: Decide eligibility. The customer is not eligible if any returned order is not delivered or cancelled (for example pending or shipped), or if the tier limit for the 60-day period is exceeded (Entry 2, Mid 3, Premium and above 4). An empty list means no pending order. If the response is ambiguous or shows an invalid id, retry once with the account-level id.
steps.quote: Confirm eligibility for replacement in the knowledge base before proceeding. Do not unlock or call the tool unless the customer is eligible.

steps.do: Do not unlock or call order_replacement_credit_card_7291. Tell the customer why: a replacement is already being processed (wait until it is delivered or cancelled), or the tier's replacement limit is reached. If the customer has a legitimate need beyond the limit, offer a manual review by a human agent.
steps.quote: Wait until the current replacement is delivered or cancelled before submitting a new request.

steps.do: Transfer the customer for a manual review of the replacement limit

args.summary: verified customer requesting a credit card replacement beyond the tier limit; reason from confirm_reason
args.reason: manual review of replacement limit requested

steps.if: not eligible because of the tier limit, the customer asks for a manual review, and the customer agrees to the transfer
steps.quote: If you believe you have a legitimate need for an additional replacement beyond these limits, contact customer support to request a manual review of your case.

steps.do: Read the primary address on file for the verified user, if it was not already read during verification
steps.if: eligible and the address on file has not been read yet in this conversation
steps.quote: Confirm the shipping address with the customer (primary or alternate, including any unit or suite information).

steps.do: Ask whether to ship to the address on file or to an alternate address. If alternate, take the full address including any suite or unit and read it back for confirmation.
steps.quote: Confirm the shipping address with the customer (primary or alternate, including any unit or suite information).

steps.do: Offer standard (7–10 business days, free) or expedited (2–3 business days) shipping, and state the expedited fee for the card's tier: Entry (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze) $15.00; Mid-tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $10.00; Premium and above (Gold, Business Gold, Platinum, Business Platinum, Diamond Elite) $0.00. For fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited. If a fee applies and the customer picks expedited, get their consent.
steps.quote: If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited shipping to minimize exposure and remind the customer to review recent transactions for unauthorized activity.

steps.if: eligible, and the customer has confirmed the address and shipping speed (and fee consent if a fee applies)

steps.do: Place the replacement order using the parameter names the unlock returns

arguments.card_or_account_id: the account id or card id of the card being replaced, from get_cc_account
arguments.shipping_address: the address the customer confirmed in confirm_address
arguments.expedited_fee_acknowledgement: true if the customer consented to the tier fee
arguments.notes: context, e.g. unrecognized charges reported; ship to alternate address; delivery instructions

steps.if: eligible, and the customer has confirmed the address and shipping speed (and fee consent if a fee applies)
steps.quote: Use call_discoverable_agent_tool with tool_name: order_replacement_credit_card_7291 and include:

steps.do: If the order call returns an error or a rejection, explain the reason (pending replacement or tier limit) and what must be resolved. Do not say the card was replaced. Offer a manual review by a human agent if the customer wants one (transfer_manual_review).
steps.if: place_order returns an error or rejection
steps.quote: If you believe you have a legitimate need for an additional replacement beyond these limits, contact customer support to request a manual review of your case.

steps.do: Tell the customer: the old card is cancelled now. The new card has a different number and CVV, and the account number stays the same. Give the delivery window (standard 7–10 / expedited 2–3 business days), the address it ships to and any fee. Say to watch for emails when the order is placed and when the card ships, and to update saved card details with merchants.
steps.quote: The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.

steps.do: For fraud_suspected or stolen, remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges in the app or website. File a dispute only if the customer asks for one.
steps.quote: If the reason was fraud_suspected or stolen, remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges in the app or website.

done_when: One of these is true. (1) order_replacement_credit_card_7291 has been called once with the confirmed reason, the customer-confirmed shipping address, the chosen speed and any fee consent, and the customer has been told: the old card is cancelled, the new number and CVV, the delivery window, any fee and the email notifications, plus (for fraud_suspected or stolen) the reminder to review and dispute unauthorized charges. (2) It was already ordered earlier in the conversation, and the customer was told so. (3) The customer is not eligible, and the reason and next steps (wait, or a manual review) have been explained. In every case, if the customer also wanted a credit limit increase on the same card that was not yet decided, they were told before ordering that the replacement would block it, and the order they chose was followed.
